title: The Three Billy Goats Gruff
authors: Traditional Norwegian tale, retold for Storytime Library
description: Three goat brothers want to reach the sweet grass across the river — but a grumpy troll lives under the bridge. A trip-trapping retelling of the Norwegian classic.

pages.alt: Three goats of different sizes stand on a dry, yellowish hillside.
pages.text: Once there were three billy goat brothers named Gruff. On their side of the river the grass was nibbled short — but across the water the meadow grew green and sweet.

pages.alt: A wooden bridge crosses a wide blue river between green hills.
pages.text: The only way across was an old wooden bridge. And under that bridge lived a grumpy old troll who liked the river loud and the bridge quiet.

pages.alt: The smallest goat crosses the bridge while the troll rises from underneath.
pages.text: Trip-trap, trip-trap went the littlest goat. “WHO trip-traps over MY bridge?” roared the troll. “Only little me,” said the goat. “Wait for my bigger brother — he makes a much finer trip-trap.” And the troll let him pass.

pages.alt: The middle-sized goat crosses the bridge as the troll watches crossly.
pages.text: TRIP-TRAP, TRIP-TRAP went the middle goat. “WHO stomps over MY bridge?” growled the troll. “Only middle-sized me,” said the goat. “Wait for my big brother — his hooves ring like drums!” And the troll waited.

pages.alt: The biggest goat with curved horns stands tall on the bridge, facing the troll.
pages.text: TRIP! TRAP! TRIP! TRAP! The great big goat stepped onto the bridge, horns first. “WHO thunders over MY bridge?” bellowed the troll. “I do,” said the big goat. “And I've been practising my push.”

pages.alt: The troll splashes into the river with a great splash.
pages.text: One firm, fair push — and SPLASH! The troll tumbled into the cool river, where he bobbed and grumbled and finally floated away downstream to find a quieter bridge.

pages.alt: All three goats graze happily in a golden evening meadow full of flowers.
pages.text: And so the three billy goats Gruff munched the sweet green grass until their tummies were round as barrels. Trip-trap, trip-trap… snip-snap-snout, this tale's told out!
